instruction:
The init file is located at C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. You need to import it via Revit's "Open IFC" feature (File > Open > IFC) before doing the task.

Single Storey Kindergarten Retrofit IFC

This task starts from init.ifc and uses the local reference image init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a single-storey kindergarten layout and export the completed model as result.ifc in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains result.ifc, and result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 6 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, 2 IfcRoof entities, and 8 IfcWindow entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token lobby at least once, classroom at least 2 times, nap at least once, kitchen at least once, and toilet at least once.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
